title: MYCELIUM RELAY
description: A branching population searches a moving nutrient ecology and retains its grown paths. Dragging does not move an object: it plants a persistent nutrient trail that the organism gradually discovers, follows and amplifies.

visual_finish.composition: a wide branching organism crossing several off-axis nutrient basins with intentional dark voids
visual_finish.material_model: phosphorescent fungal threads with dense cores, soft hyphal bloom and granular growing tips
